description: This Java source file defines the SimpleXStreamSerializer class, which implements serialization and deserialization of objects using the XStream library within the OpenMRS framework. It manages security configurations, whitelists for types, and handles custom setup for serialization.

classes.name: SimpleXStreamSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that uses XStream to serialize and deserialize objects within the OpenMRS platform, with security and whitelist management features.

classes.name: OpenmrsDynamicProxyConverter
classes.description: A nested class that extends DynamicProxyConverter to prevent serialization and deserialization of proxies, ensuring security during the XStream process.
